summary: ⑥ Optimize-loop control DONE. Added mechanical converged-vs-iterate decision closing the propose→measure→judge cycle. NEW lib/optimize.js: pure decideOptimize(P) over P's chronological judge verdicts + budget + config. Precedence: target-converged → stuck(escalate) → diminishing-converged → budget → iterate. Wired into daemon.decideAction drained branch (additive; no metric problem ⇒ unchanged drained→plan/stop). iterate returns action:'optimize' with prior_verdict fed to self-learn-planner; stuck routes through request_guidance (NEVER auto-cancel/replan); converged/budget mark P closed + fall through. overlay.setOptimize tracks closed + verdict-count so iterate can't tight-loop. Config knobs optimize.{epsilon:0.01, diminishing_rounds:3}; budget reuses loop tokenBudget. Tests: optimize.test.js 31/31 (all 5 outcomes), smoke 83/83, full suite 13 suites green. README + orch-loop skill documented. Daemon NOT restarted — dormant until user restarts :8787.
